items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry states Raymond James offers the largest addressable market in the industry because it has all the affiliation options an adviser could want, and is agnostic about how an adviser affiliates, wanting advisers to be drawn by the culture, values, platform and capabilities.
items.quote: we have the largest addressable market in the industry because we have all the affiliation options that an adviser could possibly want. And we have adviser choice where we're agnostic into how you affiliate with Raymond James. We want you to fall in love with our culture, values and the platform and capabilities and how you affiliate with us, we're indifferent to.

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry states the firm does not lead with the highest check but with culture and capabilities, and that it has a true differentiated value proposition while remaining disciplined on transition assistance and economics to advisers.
items.quote: we don't lead with the highest check. We want to have competitive economics. Certainly, we have to have competitive economics, but we lead with culture and capabilities. And so we have a true differentiated value proposition.

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry states the firm is focused on the long term and providing a stable platform, attracting and retaining financial advisors with its unique culture, leading service and robust platform rather than the largest check, and valuing independence.
items.quote: We are focused on the long-term and providing a stable platform for our advisors, bankers, and associates, whereas so many of our competitors are increasingly looking for an exit in three to five years or even less. We attract and retain financial advisors with our unique culture, leading service, and robust platform, whereas many of our competitors compete with the largest check.

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry states the value proposition is having the largest addressable market across affiliation options, from employee to independent contractor to RIA custody, with critical mass and decades of experience in all of them.
items.quote: we have the largest addressable market across our affiliation options, from employee to independent contractor to the RIA custody, and we have critical mass and decades of experience in all of them. It's not a new venture for us.

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry states advisers do not have to choose between culture and capabilities, as the firm offers a unique combination of an adviser- and client-focused culture with leading technology, products and solutions, combined with a strong balance sheet, long-term thinking and commitment to independence.
items.quote: At Raymond James, advisers do not have to choose between culture and capabilities. We offer a unique combination of an adviser and client-focused culture together with leading technologies, products and solutions advisers need to serve clients at a high level.

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry states recruiting is a long-term process that cannot be dialed up or down quarter by quarter, and that the firm wants advisors who want to be there over the long term rather than those moving for the highest check.
items.quote: It's a marathon, not a sprint... if you dial up recruiting quarter by quarter or dial it down quarter by quarter, then you're not gonna get the quality advisors that you want... We have to have a competitive check, but we want the advisors that want to be here over the long term.
